_comment: Runtime identity -> catalog model_id translation for the Bazzite edge worker.
EDGE-WORKER-CONTRACT §1: active_model and cached_models carry the CATALOG
model_id (the key in the catalog `models` table), never the upstream_model_id
that agentgateway sends to the server. A runtime knows its own identity, not
the catalog's, so the edge producer translates before sending. The router
does not guess and keeps no alias table.
runtime_to_catalog: llama.cpp --alias / llama-swap model id -> catalog model_id.
artifact_to_catalog: on-disk GGUF filename -> catalog model_id, which is how
cached_models is derived (artifact present on local storage, loadable without
An id that appears in neither table is NOT sent. scripts/edge-heartbeat.sh
drops it and warns on stderr, because a value the router cannot resolve
against the catalog is an observability alarm rather than a placement input.
